claim_scope: target-orbit 28 nm SRAM-class engineering BER delivery

radiation_rate_input.rate_semantics: measured 28 nm memory-class proxy envelope integrated over target SPENVIS spectra

operation_model.write_window_source: current PTM32 architecture-LUT write testbench WREN high from 0.15 ns to 1.70 ns
operation_model.read_window_source: current PTM32 architecture-LUT latch sense amplifier enabled from 0.80 ns to 1.70 ns
operation_model.refresh_assumption: each refresh/write restores a known-correct stored state
operation_model.radiation_process: independent Poisson SBU arrivals; each admitted event toggles one stored bit

peripheral_design.technology_model: PTM 32 nm LP BSIM4 predictive model, not a foundry PDK
peripheral_design.local_bitline: differential BL/BLB; CBL=2+0.140625*local_rows fF, giving 20 fF at 128 local rows
peripheral_design.precharge_equalize: two PMOS precharge devices plus one NMOS equalizer on each local and global differential bitline pair
peripheral_design.column_mux: one selected 1-of-M branch represented by a voltage-controlled finite-resistance switch, Ron=200 ohm; other branches enter through global-bitline capacitance
peripheral_design.global_bitline: differential GBL/GBLB; CGBL=2+0.75*mux fF, giving 5 fF at 4:1 mux
peripheral_design.sense_amplifier: clocked cross-coupled differential voltage latch with PMOS header and NMOS tail; one sense amplifier per post-mux output bit
peripheral_design.write_path: complementary full-swing ideal data sources drive BL/BLB through the finite-resistance selected branch
peripheral_design.control: PRE/EQ/COL/WL/SAEN/WREN are ideal PWL voltage sources; transistor-level decoder, clock generator and write driver are not included
peripheral_design.segmentation: selected local segment is explicit through local_rows and CBL; unselected segment selectors and global routing are not fully transistor-netlisted
peripheral_design.baseline_organization: 128 rows per local bitline, 4:1 column mux; 128 physical columns therefore provide 32 post-mux outputs and 32 sense amplifiers
peripheral_design.not_included: PEX/global-wire RC, unselected-cell pattern leakage, package parasitics and target layout

electrical_boundary.ngspice_condition: nominal PVT, central TID corner at 14.32 krad(Si)
electrical_boundary.policy: functional/mismatch screening only; finite-sample Wilson limit is not added to radiation BER and is not a per-access temporal BER

excluded: SEL, SEFI, stuck bits and permanent failures
sense-amplifier and write-driver transient cross sections
